landed_against.rule: R-17/D-97 — the unit declares its moved leaves; the orchestrator re-captures once at integration close

what_moved_and_why.Trundle W (Frozen Domain): The compiled packet gave W a no-damage placeholder row. The slot now reads the cached 'Bonus Attack Speed' row (30/45/60/75/90% by rank) through slotlib.stat_buff, so damage.py's bonus_attack_speed dispatch reaches the auto stream. Every moved number in registered_champion_fights is Trundle's auto count rising with it (level 18 no_items auto_attacks 480.0 -> 768.0, +60%; the on-hit and Shadowflame rows follow the same swings). The ability row itself changes shape: cooldown 0.0 -> 16.0 (the cached W cooldown the placeholder never read), damage_type magic -> physical (stat_buff's steroid default), the placeholder detail drops, and parts[0] plus stat_buff appear.
what_moved_and_why.Dr. Mundo P (Goes Where He Pleases): P gains a slot. Its row is zero-damage and carries self_heal_state.per_half_second for the self-heal rule — the cached P's SECOND 'Max Health Damage' row (0.04% : 0.23% of maximum health every 0.5 s, mislabelled as damage in the cache). No fight total moves: the pair golden does not carry self-healing.
what_moved_and_why.Mordekaiser R (Realm of Death): The R row gains self_heal_state {percent 10.0, amount 200.0} — 10% of the banished champion's maximum health, from the cached R prose — and its detail names the drain. No fight total moves for the same reason.
what_moved_and_why.Vi P (Blast Shield): P gains a slot holding the sourced 12%-maximum-health / 3-second self-shield payload, and Q carries the same payload onto its first damage event so the ledger can grant it. Defensive only: no damage total moves.
what_moved_and_why.Cho'Gath P (Carnivore): The coupled rotation rationale gains the new p_carnivore_kills option in its classified-options sentence. Text only; the option defaults to 0 kills, so no number moves anywhere.

measured.coupled_golden: 3 differing leaves: the two enumerated above plus /metadata/fingerprint/leaves, already claimed by an earlier receipt; no coupled number moved

numbers_that_did_not_move.option_gated_heals: Cho'Gath P (p_carnivore_kills), Trundle P (p_nearby_deaths), Rek'Sai P (p_burrow_fury) and Alistar P (p_triumph_stacks) all default to 0, so a default request emits no receipt and no number moves — plan decision 5's disclosed default, and decision 10's identical-by-default requirement.
numbers_that_did_not_move.self_healing: The pair golden carries no self-healing leaf, so Dr. Mundo's and Mordekaiser's new heals move nothing there; they are pinned by tests/test_w2_sustain_heals.py instead.
